context: Change skill-sync.yaml to a git source at https://github.com/joeharris76/skill-sync-skills.git with ref c52db1dcfebc76283046c7eaa5794aaaca25cff2; restore docs in skills; run make skill-sync and verify; review that generated changes are limited to source provenance plus docs restoration; preserve the dirty ~/.skill-sync checkout byte-for-byte.
description: PR #1318 still sources skills from the mutable local path ~/.skill-sync/skills while that checkout contains preserved uncommitted docs-skill deletions. The interrupted implementation removed docs from BenchBox's manifest based on that WIP even though skill-sync-skills main at c52db1dcfebc76283046c7eaa5794aaaca25cff2 still contains skills/docs. Replace the local source with the canonical Git repository pinned to that exact merged commit, restore docs to the manifest, and regenerate tracked mirrors. This closes the provenance gap and prevents user WIP from leaking into project governance.

anti_patterns.why: Local uncommitted state is not repository authority

anti_patterns.dont: Use a floating branch ref for this corrective regeneration
anti_patterns.why: A fresh regeneration must resolve the same bytes
